title: Event Horizon
description: Real-time WebGL2 black hole ray tracer spanning the entire no-hair family — Schwarzschild, spinning Kerr, and now charged Kerr–Newman / Reissner–Nordström: live null-geodesic integration, frame dragging and an off-axis shadow, a charge that shrinks the horizon and shadow, a volumetric self-shadowing accretion disk with exact relativistic shifts and a live line spectrograph, a free-fall 'rain frame' plunge (with the Kerr ZAMO drift) and per-wavelength starfield redshift, HDR bloom, and a click-a-photon probe that traces any pixel's geodesic and reads off its conserved E, L and Carter's Q — plus a light-echo highlight that isolates the photon ring, and an Observatory that computes the exact analytic shadow (Kerr-Newman critical curve and all) and verifies the whole engine live with a 33-check GR self-test suite.
